Terms and Conditions

Version 2026-11-09. Published 9 November 2026.

Who runs Dibs

Dibs is a trading name used in the United Kingdom. Contact: [email protected]. These terms cover the website at dibs.fit and the Dibs app at app.dibs.fit. The Privacy notice explains personal-data use.

Dibs is an independent assistant, not a gym, booking platform or gym representative. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the gyms it supports. Your gym membership, classes, credits and purchases remain contracts with the relevant gym or provider.

Your account and gym permissions

Use your own account and only connect gym accounts you are authorised to use. Keep your Dibs password and devices secure; tell us promptly if access is compromised. Give accurate instructions and meet each gym's membership, age and booking requirements.

Before connecting a gym or enabling automation, check that its terms allow third-party access, credential use and automated booking. You remain responsible for complying with those terms, booking limits and fair-use rules. Your permission to Dibs does not override a gym's rules or oblige a gym to accept our requests. Do not use Dibs to evade access restrictions, obtain unauthorised access or misuse other members' information.

Connecting a gym authorises Dibs to store its provider session and use it to retrieve your account and class information and carry out the features and instructions you enable. If you choose “Remember your gym login”, you also authorise Dibs to store copies of your gym login email and password and use them to sign in on your behalf. Without that choice, Dibs uses your login details only to authenticate and does not retain them for later sign-in. You can forget saved gym login details in Settings while keeping your current session and gym setup. When a session cannot be renewed, syncing and automation pause for that gym until you log in again. Gym passwords and sessions are encrypted in storage, but the server can decrypt them to operate these features. This is not end-to-end encryption. Use a separate Dibs password.

Bookings, automation and charges

Auto-Book and Auto-Upgrade can act while the app is closed. Depending on your instructions and the gym's capabilities, this can book or change a place, join a waitlist, or cancel and rebook a class. It can use gym credits or create obligations under gym rules. Review your selections, schedules, cancellation deadlines and notification settings carefully.

Dibs cannot guarantee a class, spot, upgrade, release time, notification or uninterrupted access. Gym systems can change, reject requests or provide delayed information. Check important bookings and deadlines directly with the gym; do not rely solely on Dibs or a reminder. Contact the gym about attendance, refunds and its charges. You are responsible for charges resulting from your valid instructions and your own failure to meet gym rules; this does not remove our responsibility for loss caused by our breach of these terms or other legal duties.

Sharing and stopping

Teams and exported booking summaries can reveal where and when you train. Review the sharing choices before joining a Team or sending a summary. Recipients may retain information they already received; changing a setting cannot recall their copies. Do not share another person's private information without authority.

You can remove queued automation, unlink a gym or delete your Dibs account in Settings. Unlinking or deleting Dibs does not cancel bookings already held by a gym, end your gym membership, or remove a calendar entry/copy already downloaded elsewhere. Check and manage those directly. The Privacy notice explains remaining backups and retention.

Availability and responsibility

We will use reasonable care and skill in providing Dibs. We may interrupt features for maintenance, security or gym compatibility, and may suspend misuse or access that creates a security or legal risk. Where practical we will explain the reason and give notice; urgent action may be necessary. If a feature ends, manage outstanding bookings directly with the gym.

We are responsible for reasonably foreseeable loss caused by our breach of these terms or failure to use reasonable care and skill. We are not responsible for losses caused solely by a gym, a failure outside our reasonable control that reasonable care could not prevent, or your failure to follow clear instructions. Dibs is for personal use; we do not accept responsibility for business losses from commercial use.

Nothing in these terms excludes liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, or any responsibility or consumer/data-protection right that law does not allow us to exclude. There is no blanket waiver for loss of credentials or personal data.

Changes and disputes

We will explain material changes before they apply and give you a reasonable opportunity to stop using Dibs. Changes will not retrospectively remove rights you already have. Contact us first to try to resolve a problem.

These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales. You keep any mandatory protections and right to use the courts available to you under the law where you live. No term requires you to waive those rights.

Privacy Policy

Version 2026-11-09. Published 9 November 2026.

Who is responsible

Dibs operates in the United Kingdom at dibs.fit and app.dibs.fit. Privacy contact: [email protected]. This notice covers Dibs; gyms and services you use separately have their own notices.

What we collect and why

InformationPurpose and UK GDPR basis
Dibs email, password hash, name and account/settings recordsCreate and secure your account and provide the service you request: contract.
Linked gym sessions; gym login email and encrypted password only if you choose to remember them; provider profile, membership/credit and class informationConnect to your chosen gym, show your account and bookings, keep history and run enabled booking/sync features: contract.
Bookings, waitlists, class history, favourite classes/spots, automation instructions and outcomesProvide your timetable, booking assistance, reminders and activity views: contract. These records come from you and linked gym/provider APIs.
Team memberships and sharing choices; information you choose to shareProvide optional Team features you request: contract. You control participation and per-Team visibility.
Push subscription/device routing details and calendar tokensDeliver optional notifications and private calendar feeds you request: contract; browser permission is also required for push.
Technical/security logs, request metadata and support messagesProtect accounts, investigate faults and respond to support: legitimate interests in running a secure, reliable service. Legal obligations apply where retention/disclosure is required by law.
Landing visits/clicks, page/referrer host, broad device/country and campaign informationUnderstand use of the landing page: legitimate interests in understanding and improving the site.

Account credentials enable sign-in; gym access details enable a connection. Other features are optional. Without necessary information we cannot provide that feature. Dibs sign-in is separate from gym sign-in.

Credentials and access

Your Dibs password is a salted scrypt hash. “Remember your gym login” starts unticked on every gym login. Without it, your login inputs are used only to authenticate; Dibs retains encrypted provider session/refresh material, not reusable gym login email/password. If selected, Dibs saves your gym login details only after successful authentication. You can remove saved login details in Settings without disconnecting the gym or ending its working session. Syncing and automation pause when a gym needs a new login. Provider profile contact information is not used as a replacement login identifier. Gym passwords and provider sessions use AES-256-GCM encryption with a server key outside the database. The server can decrypt them to renew access and run background features. The operator can access account information; control of the server and key permits decryption. Other database information is not necessarily encrypted.

The public service uses HTTPS. Security cannot eliminate breach risk. Never send passwords in support messages.

Who receives information

We send relevant credentials, sessions and requests to the gyms/providers you connect. Their rules govern their own processing. Oracle Cloud hosts the live app and its database. Cloudflare provides DNS, tunnel, network security and delivery services, access controls and email routing; it may also process network and security metadata for its own purposes. Encrypted backups support recovery: they can be restored by an operator with the appropriate keys and are not end-to-end encrypted. Browser push services route enabled notifications. Calendar providers receive the contents of feeds you subscribe to. For supported credit purchases, Dibs displays saved payment-method details such as card brand, last four digits and expiry, and sends the selected payment-method identifier to the gym provider to request payment. The gym and its payment provider handle the charge; the final payment steps have not been verified live.

Team members see information allowed by your sharing settings. The joining screen initially selects gyms, upcoming classes, waitlists, activity and recent classes; spots, Auto-Book queue and competition start off. Review these choices. Counts may remain visible when class details are hidden. Sharing reveals times/locations. Changing settings cannot recall screenshots or exports.

Anyone with a private calendar URL can read its feed. Keep it secret and regenerate it if exposed. We may disclose necessary information for legal obligations or claims.

International processing: The live app and database are hosted in London. Cloudflare operates a global network and information may be processed outside the UK; other providers you use may also process information internationally. Cloudflare publishes a data processing addendum with standard contractual clauses and a UK transfer addendum for qualifying transfers, but their application to this service and the complete destinations and safeguards have not yet been established. Contact [email protected] for the information currently available.

Device storage and landing analytics

Local storage holds sign-in/preferences, IndexedDB caches account data, and service-worker caches support offline operation. Uninstalling does not delete your server account.

Landing analytics do not set an analytics cookie. The server derives a daily-changing identifier from the IP address, user agent and secret; the analytics table stores that identifier rather than the raw IP or user agent. This is pseudonymous, not guaranteed anonymous. Network/security providers may separately process IP addresses. You can object to this measurement by contacting [email protected].

Retention and choices

Account and class-history records remain until you delete your account or unlink the relevant gym; there is currently no automatic deletion solely for inactivity. The 30-day Team recent-class view limits visibility, not storage. Unlinking deletes that gym's credentials, sessions and gym-scoped data from the live database. Settings also offers account deletion. This does not cancel gym bookings or delete provider-held records. Landing events are scheduled for deletion after 13 months.

Security logs and support correspondence may be retained to investigate problems, protect the service or deal with legal matters; a fixed retention period has not yet been established. Deleted information can remain in recovery backups and other copies after deletion from the live database. The app database backup job is configured to prune local copies after 14 days and remote copies after 30 days; this is a rotation target, not a guarantee covering failed jobs, other backups or restored copies. We cannot yet give a reliable deletion deadline for every copy.

Your rights and contact

You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction and portability, subject to applicable conditions. You can object to processing based on legitimate interests, including landing analytics; contact [email protected]. Any consent can be withdrawn without affecting earlier lawful use. You can disable optional features, change Team sharing, revoke browser push permission and regenerate calendar links.

Automation follows your booking instructions and may affect gym credits or charges; you can remove queued instructions and check outcomes with the gym. It is not a guarantee of acceptance by the gym.

Contact us about concerns or rights. You can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office. We will date updates and explain material changes before new uses begin.
